name: orchestration
description: Orchestration rules for Claude Code and Codex CLI: a main session that coordinates, narrow role-based subagents (explorer, worker, researcher, scanner), a cross-family critic, and guard hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate subagents by role, with a cross-family critic and guard hooks
interface.longDescription: A main session that plans, briefs, checks and synthesises while narrow subagents explore, implement and research. Includes a read-budget hook, a superpowers version watcher, and a cross-family critic script.
